qe: Which of the following is a characteristic operational property of an Acid?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक अम्ल (Acid) का विशिष्ट रासायनिक व भौतिक गुण है?
o: Turns blue litmus paper red and has a pH below 7
Evolution of oxygen with active metals
e: Acid ki pehchaan uske rasayanik gun se hoti hai - tezaab (acid) neela litmus paper ko laal kar deta hai, aur uski pH 7 se kam hoti hai, kyunki wo paani mein ghulkar hydrogen ion (H+) yani hydronium ion (H3O+) chhodta hai. Kadwa swaad aur soapsa touch base (kshaar) ke gun hain, isliye wo galat hai; laal litmus ko neela karna bhi base ka kaam hai; aur kriyasheel dhatuon (active metals jaise zinc) ke saath hydrogen gas nikalti hai, oxygen nahi - isliye wo vikalp bhi galat hai. Yaad rakhein: acid = H+ deta hai, base = OH- deta hai, aur pH 7 se kam hona hi acid ka pramaan hai. Exam point: acid neela litmus ko laal karta hai aur pH 7 se kam hoti hai; H+ ion ka sraavan (release) hi asli karan hai.

qe: Which organic carboxylic acid is present in commercial culinary 'Vinegar' (Sirka)?
qh: सिरके (Vinegar) में मुख्य रूप से कौन सा कार्बनिक अम्ल पाया जाता है?
e: Sirka (vinegar) mein mukhya tezaab acetic acid (ethanoic acid, CH3COOH) hota hai, jo 5-8% ke ghulaimaan par khane mein swaad aur parisarvan (preservative) ka kaam karta hai. Ye ek kamzor kaarbooxilik acid hai jo acetate ka namak aur ester banata hai. Lactic acid dahi aur chhachh mein, citric acid neebu-santare mein aur tartaric acid imli-angoor mein milta hai - isliye ye teen vikalp galat hain, kyunki sawaal khaas tor par sirke ke baare mein hai. Sirka banana do tarah se hota hai: pehle sharaab (ethanol) ka fermentation, phir acetobacter bacteria dwara acetic acid mein badalna. Exam point: sirka = 5-8% acetic acid (ethanoic acid, CH3COOH); dahi mein lactic, neebu mein citric aur imli mein tartaric acid hota hai.

qe: What is the exact pH value of chemically pure neutral water at standard room temperature (25°C)?
qh: मानक कमरे के तापमान (25°C) पर शुद्ध उदासीन जल का pH मान कितना होता है?
e: 25 degree Celsius par shudh (pure) paani ki pH theek 7.0 hoti hai - ise neutral kehte hain, kyunki usme H+ aur OH- ionon ki sankhya barabar hoti hai. pH 0 bahut prabal acid ka, pH 14 prabal base ka hota hai, aur pH 1 bhi tez acid ka. pH ka matlab hai hydrogen ion ki sadhanata (concentration) ka ulta logarithm (negative log): pH = -log[H+]. Dhyan rahe ki pH 7 ka matlab hamesha 'paani' nahi hota - kuchh lavan (salts) ka ghulaimaan bhi neutral ho sakta hai, aur taapmaan badhne par shudh paani ki pH bhi thodi gir jaati hai, par wo neutral hi rehta hai. Exam point: 25 degree C par shudh paani ki pH 7.0 aur neutral hoti hai; pH = -log[H+].

qe: Which basic magnesium suspension is commercially known as 'Milk of Magnesia' and used as an antacid?
qh: पेट की अम्लता और एसिडिटी को दूर करने के लिए 'मिल्क ऑफ मैग्नीशिया' के रूप में किस क्षार का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Magnesium hydroxide [Mg(OH)2] ek halka (mild) base hai jiska paani mein nilaamban (suspension) 'Milk of Magnesia' ke naam se bikta hai; ye pet ki tezaab (gastric acid, HCl) ko udasin (neutralise) karke jalan mein rahat deta hai. Calcium hydroxide ko slaked lime ya lime water kehte hain, sodium hydroxide caustic soda hai aur potassium hydroxide caustic potash - ye teen bahut prabal base hain, isliye dawa mein antacid ke roop mein seedhe istemal nahi hote (ye ootak ko nuksan pahuncha sakte hain). Isi tarah magnesium hydroxide ka jalane ka prabhav halka hota hai, isliye wo bachchon ke antacid mein bhi chalta hai. Exam point: Milk of Magnesia = magnesium hydroxide Mg(OH)2 ka suspension, antacid ke roop mein; caustic soda NaOH aur caustic potash KOH prabal base hain.

qe: The quantitative logarithmic 'pH scale' was introduced in 1909 by which Danish biochemist?
qh: अम्लता और क्षारीयता को मापने वाले 'pH पैमाने' की खोज 1909 में किस वैज्ञानिक ने की थी?
e: pH scale ki khoj 1909 mein Danish biochemist S.P.L. Sorensen ne ki thi - unhone hydrogen ion ki bahut chhoti sadhanata ko aasaani se likhne ke liye logarithm wala scale banaya. Svante Arrhenius ne acid-base ka aayanik siddhant (1884-87) diya, G.N. Lewis ne 1923 mein electron-pair wala siddhant diya aur Johannes Bronsted ne proton transfer (proton donor-acceptor) ka siddhant diya - ye sab alag-alag yogdaan hain, pH scale ke aavishkar se jude nahi. Isliye sawaal ke sahi jod Sorensen hai. Exam point: pH scale ka aavishkar 1909 mein S.P.L. Sorensen ne kiya; Arrhenius, Bronsted aur Lewis ke siddhant acid-base ki paribhashayein hain, pH scale ka avishkar nahi.

qe: Which organic acid is injected by ant bites and bee stings, causing local burning pain and inflammation?
qh: चींटी के डंक और मधुमक्खी के काटने पर त्वचा में जलन पैदा करने वाला कौन सा अम्ल स्रावित होता है?
e: Chinti (ant) ke kaatne aur madhumakhi (bee) ke dank mein methanoic acid (formic acid, HCOOH) hota hai, jo dekhne mein hi 'chinti ka tezaab' kehlata hai - yahi twacha par jalan, laali aur soojan paida karta hai. Iske ilava ye acid chepthon (red ants) aur madhumakhi ke zeher mein paya jaata hai, aur bharat mein ise 'pipartu ka tezaab' bhi kehte hain. Nitric acid prabal khaniz tezaab hai jo aise jeevon ke dank mein nahi hota, oxalic acid palak-tamate mein aur citric acid neebu mein hota hai. Dank ke isi karan log base (jaise soap ya baking soda ka lep) lagate hain, jo acid ko udasin kar deta hai. Exam point: chinti ke kaatne aur madhumakhi ke dank mein methanoic acid (formic acid, HCOOH); ilaaj ke liye halka base lagate hain.

qe: What color transition does the synthetic indicator 'Phenolphthalein' exhibit in an alkaline/basic medium?
qh: कृत्रिम सूचक 'फिनोल्फथलीन' (Phenolphthalein) क्षारीय घोल में कौन सा रंग प्रदर्शित करता है?
e: Phenolphthalein ek synthetic indicator hai jo tezaabi (acidic) ya udasin madhyam mein rangheen (colorless) rehta hai, par kshaariya (basic/alkaline) madhyam mein gehra gulaabi (deep pink/magenta) ho jaata hai. Iska istemal school-prayogon aur titration mein hota hai, khaas tor par tezaab-base ke anuman (estimation) mein. Yellow rang methyl orange ka kshaar mein, blue rang litmus ka kshaar mein aur colorless rang phenolphthalein ka acid mein hota hai - isliye baaki vikalp galat hain. Turmeric (haldi) ek prakritik indicator hai jo kshaar mein laal-bhoora hota hai, par ye alag cheez hai. Exam point: phenolphthalein acid mein colorless aur base mein deep pink (gulaabi) ho jaata hai.

qe: Which flammable gas is evolved with effervescence when dilute mineral acids react with active metals like Zinc?
qh: जब तनु अम्ल जस्ता (Zinc) जैसी सक्रिय धातुओं से अभिक्रिया करते हैं, तो कौन सी गैस निकलती है?
e: Jab tanu (dilute) khaniz tezaab (jaise HCl ya H2SO4) kriyasheel dhatuon (zinc, magnesium, iron) ke saath kriya karta hai, to dhaatu tezaab ko vidhate (displace) kar hydrogen gas (H2) chhodti hai aur lavan (salt) banta hai - isi karan bulbulein (effervescence) dikhti hain aur gas jalne wali ke nazdeek 'pop' ki awaaz karti hai. Nitrogen, oxygen ya carbon dioxide yahan nahi banti; CO2 tab banti hai jab tezaab carbonate ya bicarbonate par daala jaaye (jaise chuna-pathar par tezaab). Isliye 'hydrogen gas' hi sahi jod hai. Exam point: tanu tezaab + kriyasheel dhaatu (jaise Zn) se hydrogen gas (H2) nikalti hai aur lavan banta hai - isi se effervescence dikhta hai.

qe: The stoichiometric exothermic chemical reaction between an Acid and a Base yielding a Salt and Water is:
qh: अम्ल और क्षार की परस्पर अभिक्रिया से लवण (Salt) और जल बनने की प्रक्रिया क्या कहलाती है?
e: Tezaab aur kshaar (acid + base) ki kriya se lavan (salt) aur paani bante hain, aur ise udasin karan kriya (neutralization reaction) kehte hain, jo aam taur par ushmaposhak (exothermic) hoti hai - yani garmi nikalna saath-saath hota hai. Iska saamaanya samikaran: HCl + NaOH -> NaCl + H2O. Oxidation mein oxygen ka yogon ya electron ki haani hoti hai, reduction mein electron ka labh hota hai, aur esterification tezaab aur alkaahol ke beech ester banata hai - ye sab alag kriyen hain, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Aam jeevan mein antacid dawa isi udasin karan par kaam karti hai. Exam point: acid + base = neutralization, jismein salt + water banta hai (aam taur par garmi ke sath); ye kriya HCl + NaOH ke samikaran se samjhein.

qe: Which heavy industrial mineral acid is historically celebrated as the 'King of Chemicals' (Oil of Vitriol)?
qh: औद्योगिक महत्व और व्यापक उपयोग के कारण किस अम्ल को 'रसायनों का राजा' (King of Chemicals) कहा जाता है?
e: Sulfuric acid (H2SO4) ko 'King of Chemicals' aur 'Oil of Vitriol' kaha jaata hai, kyunki ye rasayanik udyog ki reedd ki haddi hai - khaniz khad (fertiliser), pigment, dye, battery aur dhatu-sanshodhan (metal processing) mein sabse zyada isi ka istemal hota hai. Iski utpadan-matara (production) kisi desh ke audyogik vikas ka paimana maani jaati hai. Nitric acid ko 'aqua fortis', hydrochloric acid ko 'muriatic acid' aur phosphoric acid ko khad-udyog mein istemal ke liye jaana jaata hai, par 'King of Chemicals' ki upadhi sirf sulfuric acid ke paas hai. Isliye sahi jod sulfuric acid (H2SO4) hai. Exam point: King of Chemicals / Oil of Vitriol = sulfuric acid (H2SO4); iski utpadan-matara udyogik vikas ka paimana hai.

qe: What is the normal, strictly buffered physiological pH range of healthy human systemic blood?
qh: स्वस्थ मानव शरीर के रक्त का सामान्य नियंत्रित pH मान कितना होता है?
e: Manav sharir ke rakt (blood) ki pH 7.35 se 7.45 ke beech hoti hai, yani halki kshaariya (slightly alkaline), jiska ausat 7.4 maana jaata hai. Ye seema ek 'buffer' vyavastha se banai rehti hai - khaas tor par carbonic acid aur bicarbonate ka jod, aur protain haemoglobin bhi buffer ka kaam karta hai. pH 6.0-6.4 ya 5.0-5.5 tak girna hoshiyari ki baat nahi, balki acidosi (acidosis) jaisi khatarnak sthiti hai; 8.2-8.6 ki pH alkalosis hai. Isliye sahi jod 7.35 se 7.45 wala hai. Exam point: rakt ki normal pH 7.35-7.45 (ausat 7.4); ye buffer vyavastha se bani rehti hai, warna acidosi/alkalosis ho jaati hai.

qe: Which naturally occurring dicarboxylic organic acid imparts the sharp sour flavor to Tamarind (Imli) and grapes?
qh: इमली और कच्चे अंगूरों में खट्टे स्वाद के लिए कौन सा प्राकृतिक अम्ल जिम्मेदार होता है?
e: Tamarind (imli) aur angoor jaise khatte phalon ka khatta swaad mukhya roop se tartaric acid se aata hai - yahi acid unhe prakritik parisarvan bhi deta hai. Ise wine udyog mein bhi 'cream of tartar' (potassium hydrogen tartrate) ke roop mein pehchana jaata hai, aur yahi acid chashme ke khaniz trap (iron trap) mein bhi hota hai. Acetic acid sirke mein, malic acid seb (apple) aur bagoochi (plum) mein, oxalic acid palak-tamate mein hota hai. Isliye 'imli ka khatta swaad' tartaric acid se juda hai, baaki teen vikalp galat hain. Exam point: imli aur angoor ka khatta swaad = tartaric acid; sirka = acetic, tamatar-palak = oxalic aur seb = malic acid.

qe: What happens to the soil chemistry when acidic agricultural farmland is amended with Quicklime (CaO) or Slaked lime [Ca(OH)2]?
qh: अम्लीय कृषि भूमि में चूना (Quicklime/Slaked lime) मिलाने पर मिट्टी के pH मान पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ता है?
e: Kheton (fields) ki acidik mitti mein quicklime (CaO) ya slaked lime [Ca(OH)2] daalne par ye base mitti ke tezaab se kriya karke use udasin (neutralise) kar dete hain, jisse mitti ki pH badh jaati hai yani mitti sudhri (kam acidic) hoti hai aur faslon ko zaroori poshak tatv aasaani se milte hain. Isliye 'mitti acidik ho jaati', 'pH gir jaati' ya 'pH same rehti' wale vikalp galat hain. Yaad rakhein ki mitti ko theek karne ka tareeka base se, aur zyada kshaariya mitti ko theek karne ka tareeka jipsum ya paara (organic matter) se hota hai - dono ulti dishaon mein hain. Exam point: acidik mitti mein chuna (CaO ya Ca(OH)2) daalne se mitti ki pH badhti hai aur mitti udasin hoti hai - kheti mein isi liye chuna istemal hota hai.

qe: Which laboratory indicator mixture displays a continuous spectral color gradation across the entire pH range from 0 to 14?
qh: विभिन्न pH मानों पर अलग-अलग रंग प्रदर्शित करके अम्ल या क्षार की सटीक प्रबलता बताने वाला सूचक कौन सा है?
e: Universal indicator ka ghulaimaan rang ka ek lambe patti (spectrum) jaisa hota hai - pH 0 par gehra laal, pH 7 par hara (udasin) aur pH 14 par gehra baingani/neela. Isliye ye ek hi ghulaimaan se poori pH range ka andaaza de deta hai, jabki litmus paper ya phenolphthalein keval do-teen rang badalte hain aur turmeric paper bhi kshaar mein laal-bhoora ho jaata hai - wo pH ka sahi maan nahi batate. Universal indicator ko pH paper (rangeen patti) par bhi lagaya jaata hai, jismein har pH ke liye alag rang-chart hota hai. Exam point: pH 0 se 14 tak lagatar rang badalne wala indicator = universal indicator; litmus aur phenolphthalein keval seemit rang badalte hain.

qe: What is the common chemical name and commercial formula of 'Bleaching Powder' used as a disinfectant?
qh: जल को कीटाणुरहित करने और विरंजन के लिए प्रयुक्त 'ब्लीचिंग पाउडर' का रासायनिक नाम व सूत्र क्या है?
e: Bleaching powder ka rasayanik naam calcium oxychloride (CaOCl2) hai, aur ye chune (Ca(OH)2) par chlorine gas ki kriya se banta hai (isliye ise chloride of lime bhi kehte hain). Ise paani ki safai, kapdon ki white-washing aur tankiyon-chhapon (sanitation) mein disinfectant ke roop mein istemal karte hain, kyunki ye paani mein gholne par chlorine chhodta hai jo jeevon ko maar deta hai. Calcium sulfate hemihydrate plaster of Paris hai, sodium bicarbonate baking soda aur sodium carbonate washing soda - ye sab alag hi rasayan hain, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Cap: bleaching powder 10-25% chlorine ke saath milta hai. Exam point: bleaching powder = calcium oxychloride (CaOCl2), chune par chlorine ki kriya se banta hai, aur paani safai/disinfectant ke liye istemal hota hai.

qe: According to the Arrhenius Theory of electrolytic dissociation, an Acid is defined as any substance that yields:
qh: आर्रेनियस सिद्धांत (Arrhenius Theory) के अनुसार अम्ल वह पदार्थ है जो जलीय विलयन में क्या प्रदान करता है?
o: Hydrogen ions (H+ / H3O+) in aqueous solution
e: Arrhenius siddhant ke anusaar acid wo padarth hai jo jal mein ghulne par hydrogen ion (H+) ya asal mein hydronium ion (H3O+) paida karta hai - jaise HCl -> H+ + Cl-. Isi tarah Arrhenius base wo hai jo jal mein hydroxide ion (OH-) deta hai. 'Non-polar solvent mein proton' ya 'aprotik' jaisi baatein Lewis/Bronsted jaisi aage ki paribhashayein hain, electron-pair wali baat Lewis ka vishay hai, aur OH- dena base ka kaam hai. Isliye sahi jod H+/H3O+ wala hai. Dhyan rakhein ki Arrhenius paribhasha keval jaleeya (aqueous) madhyam tak seemit hai - isi kami ko Lewis aur Bronsted ne door kiya. Exam point: Arrhenius acid = jal mein H+ (asli mein H3O+) deta hai; Arrhenius base = jal mein OH- deta hai.

qe: Under the electronic definition proposed by G.N. Lewis, a 'Lewis Base' is defined as an:
qh: लुईस सिद्धांत (Lewis Theory) के अनुसार 'लुईस क्षार' (Lewis Base) किसे कहा जाता है?
e: G.N. Lewis ke siddhant ke anusaar Lewis base wo hai jo ek electron yugm (electron pair) daan (donate) karta hai, kyunki uske paas akela (lone) electron yugm hota hai - jaise NH3, H2O ya F-. Isliye 'electron pair acceptor' Lewis acid hota hai, 'proton donor' Bronsted acid hota hai, aur 'hydroxyl donor exclusively' jaisi baat Lewis ki paribhasha nahi hai. Lewis ki paribhasha acid-base ko electron ke lens se dekhti hai, jinmein proton ka hona zaroori nahi hota - jaise BF3 (electron ki kami wala) Lewis acid hai. Isi liye ye paribhasha sarvadhik vyapak maani jaati hai. Exam point: Lewis base = electron pair donor (lone pair wala); Lewis acid = electron pair acceptor.

qe: Under the electronic definition proposed by G.N. Lewis, a 'Lewis Acid' is defined as an:
qh: लुईस सिद्धांत के अनुसार 'लुईस अम्ल' (Lewis Acid) किसे कहा जाता है?
e: G.N. Lewis ke electronic siddhant ke anusaar Lewis acid wo padarth hai jismein electron ki kami hoti hai (electron deficient) aur jo kisi anya padarth ka akela electron yugm (lone pair) le leta hai, yani wo electron pair acceptor hota hai - jaise BF3, AlCl3, Ag+, H+. Isliye 'proton acceptor' Bronsted base ki paribhasha hai, 'OH- donor' Arrhenius base ka vishay hai, aur 'electron pair donor' Lewis base hai - ye teeno galat jod hain. Isi siddhant se samjha ja sakta hai ki AlCl3 (Lewis acid) ki Friedel-Crafts kriya mein catalysis kaise karta hai, kyunki wo organic compound se electron yugm leta hai. Exam point: Lewis acid = electron pair acceptor (electron-deficient species); Lewis base = electron pair donor.

qe: Tooth decay and dental cavity formation initiate when mouth salivary pH drops below which critical threshold?
qh: मुँह का pH मान कितने से कम होने पर दाँतों के इनेमल का क्षरण (सड़न/Cavity) शुरू हो जाता है?
e: Daanton mein cavity banana tab shuru hota hai jab muh ki laar (saliva) ki pH 5.5 se neeche gir jaati hai; is pH par daanton ka enamal (enamel) jo calcium phosphate ka bana hota hai, tezaab mein ghulna shuru karta hai (demineralisation). Ye tezaab muh ke bacteria dwara shakkar aur bache hue bhojan ko ferment karne se banta hai - khaas tor par lactic acid. pH 8.0 aur 7.4 kshaariya hain (yahan enamal surakshit rehta hai) aur 6.8 bhi surakshit seema hai, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Upay yahi hai ki cheeni kam khayein, brushing karein aur daanto par fluoride lagwayein, jo enamal ko mazboot karta hai. Exam point: daant kharab hone ka critical threshold = muh ki pH 5.5; isse neeche enamal ghalne lagta hai (demineralisation).

qe: What is the chemical formula of commercial 'Washing Soda'?
qh: धावन सोडा (Washing Soda) का सही रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है जिसमें 10 क्रिस्टलन जल के अणु होते हैं?
e: Washing soda ka rasayanik naam sodium carbonate decahydrate hai, jiska formula Na2CO3.10H2O hai - isi ko dhone ka soda (soda ash ka crystal roop) kehte hain. Na2CO3 bina paani wala (anhydrous) soda ash hai jo sabun, kaanch aur dhulai wale powder banane mein lagta hai; NaHCO3 baking soda hai, aur NaOH caustic soda hai - ye sab alag padarth hain. Washing soda ka paani mein ghulaimaan kshaariya (basic) hota hai, isliye ye kapdon ki chikni mail (grease) todne aur paani ki sakhtai (hardness) kam karne mein madad karta hai. Isliye crystal wala jod Na2CO3.10H2O hi sahi hai. Exam point: washing soda = Na2CO3.10H2O (sodium carbonate decahydrate); NaHCO3 baking soda aur NaOH caustic soda hai.

qe: What is the commercial and domestic chemical name of 'Baking Soda'?
qh: खाने के सोडे (मीठा सोडा/Baking Soda) का रासायनिक नाम और सूत्र क्या है?
e: Baking soda ka rasayanik naam sodium bicarbonate ya sodium hydrogen carbonate hai, jiska formula NaHCO3 hai - ise ghar par kek-dhokla fulane aur antacid ke roop mein istemal karte hain. Ye halka kshaariya (mildly basic) hai aur khane ke soda ki tarah sirke ya dahi ke khatte (acid) se kriya kar carbon dioxide gas paida karta hai, jisse aata ful jaata hai. Sodium carbonate (Na2CO3) washing soda hai, potassium hydroxide caustic potash hai aur calcium carbonate chuna-pathar hai - ye sab is naam se nahi pehchane jaate. Isliye sahi jod NaHCO3 wala hai, jo khane-pine mein surakshit aur sabse aam antacid hai. Exam point: baking soda = sodium bicarbonate (sodium hydrogen carbonate), formula NaHCO3; sirke/dahi ke acid se CO2 deta hai.

qe: Commercial concentrated aqueous Sodium Chloride (NaCl) solution used in the Chlor-Alkali process is:
qh: क्लोर-क्षार प्रक्रिया में सोडियम हाइड्रॉक्साइड बनाने के लिए प्रयुक्त नमक के सांद्र जलीय घोल को क्या कहते हैं?
e: Chlor-alkali prakriya (process) mein sodium chloride ke gaadhe jal (concentrated aqueous solution) ka istemal hota hai, jise 'brine solution' kehte hain - ismein vidyut apghatan (electrolysis) se chlorine gas, hydrogen gas aur sodium hydroxide (caustic soda) banti hai. Yahi prakriya Rashtriya Rasayan (chlorine, alkali) udyog ka base hai, isliye ise chlor-alkali prakriya kaha jaata hai. Bleaching liquor, slaked lime slurry aur lime water alag padarth hain - lime water calcium hydroxide ka tanu ghulaimaan hai aur bleaching liquor mein chlorine aur chuna gholte hain, par ye sab chlor-alkali prakriya ka kachcha maal (raw feed) nahi hai. Exam point: chlor-alkali prakriya mein istemal hone wala gaadha namak ka jal = brine solution (NaCl ka concentrated ghulaimaan); isse Cl2, H2 aur NaOH banti hai.

qe: What is the chemical composition of 'Plaster of Paris' (POP) formed by heating Gypsum to 373 K (100°C)?
qh: जिप्सम को 100°C पर गर्म करने पर बनने वाले प्लास्टर ऑफ पेरिस (POP) का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
e: Plaster of Paris (POP) jipsum (gypsum, CaSO4.2H2O) ko 373 K (100 degree C) par garam karne se banta hai, jismein paani ka ek bhaag nikal jaata hai aur calcium sulfate hemihydrate (CaSO4.1/2H2O) bachta hai. Ise paani mein milane par ye punah jipsum banakar sakht hokar set ho jaata hai - isliye haddi ka plaster, murti aur gudde banane mein iska istemal hota hai. CaSO4.2H2O jipsum khud hai, CaSO4 dead burnt plaster hai (jo 393 K se upar garam karne par banta hai aur set nahi hota), aur CaCO3 chuna-pathar hai. Isliye sahi jod hemihydrate hi hai. Exam point: POP = CaSO4.1/2H2O (calcium sulfate hemihydrate), jipsum ko 373 K par garam karne se; paani se milte hi set ho jaata hai.

qe: Which organic dicarboxylic acid found in tomatoes and spinach is used to remove rust and iron-ink stains from fabric?
qh: टमाटर और पालक में पाया जाने वाला कौन सा अम्ल कपड़ों से स्याही और जंग के धब्बे हटाने में काम आता है?
e: Oxalic acid [(COOH)2] ek dicarboxylic acid hai jo tamatar (tomato) aur palak (spinach) jaise sabziyon mein milta hai, aur isi karan se ye loh (iron) ke zang (rust) aur saahii (ink) ke daagon ko kapdon se hataane mein istemal hota hai - ye loha ke saath ghulansheel samanvit (soluble complex) bana deta hai jise dhokar hata diya jaata hai. Formic acid chinti ke dank mein, acetic acid sirke mein aur malic acid seb mein hota hai - ye teen is khaas istemal ke liye nahi jane jaate. Oxalic acid zehreela bhi hota hai, isliye ise saavadhaani se istemal karte hain. Exam point: tamatar-palak wala acid = oxalic acid [(COOH)2], jo zang aur ink ke daag hatane mein kapdon par lagaya jaata hai.

qe: If the pH of an aqueous solution increases from 3 to 6, by what factor has the concentration of Hydrogen ions (H+) decreased?
qh: यदि किसी घोल का pH मान 3 से बढ़कर 6 हो जाता है, तो उसमें H+ आयनों की सांद्रता में कितने गुना कमी आई है?
e: pH 3 se 6 ho jaane ka matlab hai ki hydrogen ion (H+) ki sadhanata 3 pH ikaiyon se giri, aur pH scale logarithm (base 10) par chalti hai - isliye ek-ek ikai ka matlab 10 guna badlav hota hai. 3 ikaiyon ka antar = 10 x 10 x 10 = 1000 guna kami. 30, 3 ya 2 guna wale vikalp galat hain kyunki pH par thodi si giri bhi sadhanata mein bahut badi kami laati hai, aur aisa saadharan guna (simple multiplication) nahi hota. Isi wajah se pH 5 ka acid pH 4 ke acid se 10 guna kam tez hota hai. Formula: [H+] = 10^(-pH), isliye pH 3 par 10^-3 aur pH 6 par 10^-6 hota hai, antar 10^3 = 1000. Exam point: pH ek ikai badalne par H+ sadhanata 10 guna badalti hai; 3 ikai = 1000 guna (logarithmic scale).

qe: What is the chemical formula of 'Slaked Lime' formed when water reacts vigorously with Quicklime (CaO)?
qh: बिना बुझे चूने (CaO) में जल मिलाने पर अत्यधिक ऊष्मा के साथ बनने वाले 'बुझे हुए चूने' का सूत्र क्या है?
e: Quicklime (CaO) par paani daalne ki kriya bahut ushmaposhak (exothermic) hoti hai aur ismein calcium hydroxide [Ca(OH)2] banta hai, jise slaked lime kehte hain: CaO + H2O -> Ca(OH)2 + garmi. Isi karan chuna pakka karne mein garmi nikalti hai aur imaarati kaam mein iska istemal hota hai - slaked lime ko paint (whitewash) aur mortar mein bhi lagaya jaata hai. CaSO4 jipsum, CaCl2 calcium chloride aur CaCO3 chuna-pathar hain - ye sawaal ke samikaran ke utpaad nahi hain. Isliye Ca(OH)2 hi sahi jod hai. Exam point: slaked lime = calcium hydroxide Ca(OH)2, jo quicklime (CaO) par paani daalne par banta hai (ushmaposhak kriya).

qe: An aqueous salt solution of Ammonium Chloride (NH4Cl) tests as:
qh: अमोनियम क्लोराइड (NH4Cl) का जलीय घोल अम्लीय क्यों होता है?
o: Acidic (pH < 7, salt of strong acid HCl and weak base NH4OH)
e: Ammonium chloride (NH4Cl) prabal tezaab HCl aur kamzor kshaar NH4OH ka lavan hai - aise lavan ka jaleeya ghulaimaan tezaabi (acidic) hota hai, yani pH 7 se kam, kyunki NH4+ ion paani mein hydrolyse hokar H+ chhodta hai. Isi karan ise 'tezaabi lavan' (acidic salt) kehte hain, aur iska ghulaimaan bina rang wala hota hai. 'Prabal kshaariya' ya 'udasin' wale vikalp galat hain kyunki prabal acid ka asar prabal hota hai; DHYAN rakhein: prabal acid + kamzor base ka lavan acidik, kamzor acid + prabal base ka lavan kshaariya, aur prabal acid + prabal base ka lavan udasin hota hai. Exam point: prabal acid aur kamzor base ka lavan (NH4Cl) acidik hota hai; pH 7 se kam (salt hydrolysis ka siddhant).

qe: An aqueous salt solution of Sodium Acetate (CH3COONa) tests as:
qh: सोडियम एसीटेट (CH3COONa) का जलीय घोल क्षारीय क्यों होता है?
o: Basic (pH > 7, salt of weak acid CH3COOH and strong base NaOH)
e: Sodium acetate (CH3COONa) kamzor tezaab (acetic acid) aur prabal kshaar (NaOH) ka lavan hai, isliye iska jaleeya ghulaimaan kshaariya (basic, pH 7 se zyada) hota hai - yahan acetate ion paani se kriya karke OH- paida karta hai (anion hydrolysis). Isi karan ise kshaariya lavan kehte hain, jo saabun jaisa mehsoos ho sakta hai. Acidik, strictly neutral ya inert wale vikalp galat hain kyunki kamzor acid ka asar kam aur prabal base ka asar prabal hota hai. Yaad rakhein: yehi kaaran hai ki aise lavan ka ghulaimaan saabun jaise bhauke ke saath safai mein istemal hota hai. Exam point: kamzor acid aur prabal base ka lavan (sodium acetate) kshaariya hota hai; pH 7 se zyada (anion hydrolysis se OH- banta hai).

qe: Which natural organic acid is primarily responsible for the tart flavor of fresh Apples?
qh: सेब (Apple) में मुख्य रूप से कौन सा प्राकृतिक अम्ल पाया जाता है?
e: Seb (apple) ka khatta-tart swaad mukhya roop se malic acid se aata hai - jo ek dicarboxylic acid hai aur seb ke saath-saath bagoochi (plum), cherry aur nashpati mein bhi milta hai. Isi acid ki maatra se seb ke rang aur swaad mein farq aata hai; wine udyog mein bhi malolactic fermentation ke naam se ye mahatvapurn hai. Dahi-chhachh mein lactic acid, neebu-santare mein citric acid aur imli-angoor mein tartaric acid hota hai - in teeno ka seb se koi talluq nahi hai. Isliye sahi jod malic acid hai. Exam point: seb ka khatta swaad = malic acid; dahi = lactic, neebu = citric aur imli = tartaric acid.

qe: What is the mineral acid threshold defining environmental 'Acid Rain'?
qh: पर्यावरण में वर्षा जल का pH मान कितने से कम होने पर उसे 'अम्लीय वर्षा' (Acid Rain) कहा जाता है?
e: Acid rain (tezaabi baarish) us varsha-jal ko kehte hain jiski pH 5.6 se kam ho - ye seema isliye tay hui kyunki saadharan jal mein hawa ki carbon dioxide ghul kar carbonic acid banati hai, jisse shudh baarish ka pH khud lagbhag 5.6 hota hai. Isse kam pH tab hota hai jab hawa mein sulfur dioxide (SO2) aur nitrogen ke oksaid (NOx) milein, jo koyla-petroleum jalane aur dhatu sanshodhan se nikalte hain; ye paani se mil kar sulfuric aur nitric acid banate hain. pH 7 udasin hota hai aur 8.2 kshaariya, isliye wo vikalp acid rain ki paribhasha nahi hain; pH 6.5 bhi threshold nahi hai. Exam point: acid rain = pH 5.6 se kam; karan SO2 aur NOx; carbon dioxide se banne wali carbonic acid se saadharan baarish ka pH 5.6 hota hai.

qe: What color transition does the synthetic indicator 'Methyl Orange' exhibit in an acidic solution?
qh: सिंथेटिक सूचक 'मेथिल ऑरेंज' (Methyl Orange) अम्लीय माध्यम में कौन सा रंग देता है?
e: Methyl orange ek synthetic indicator hai jo tezaabi (acidic) ghulaimaan mein laal ya gulaabi-laal rang deta hai, aur kshaariya (basic) ghulaimaan mein peela ho jaata hai - isliye ise strong acid aur strong base ke titration mein istemal karte hain. Acid mein bilkul rang na hona phenolphthalein ki khaas baat hai, pH 7 par hara dikhna universal indicator ka kaam hai, aur methyl orange khud base mein peela ho jaata hai - ye teeno baatein sawaal se alag hain. Yaad rakhein: methyl orange ka rang tezaab mein laal aur kshaar mein peela, jabki phenolphthalein ka tezaab mein colorless aur kshaar mein gulaabi. Exam point: methyl orange acid mein laal/gulaabi-laal aur base mein peela ho jaata hai; strong acid-strong base titration mein istemal hota hai.

qe: Why are metallic oxides such as Aluminum Oxide (Al2O3) and Zinc Oxide (ZnO) classified as 'Amphoteric Oxides'?
qh: एल्युमिनियम ऑक्साइड (Al2O3) और जिंक ऑक्साइड (ZnO) को 'उभयधर्मी ऑक्साइड' (Amphoteric) क्यों कहा जाता है?
o: They dissolve only in neutral water
They are gaseous at room temperature
They react with both strong acids and strong bases to yield salt and water
e: Amphoteric oxide wo oxide hote hain jo tezaab aur kshaar dono ke saath kriya karke lavan aur paani banaate hain - jaise Al2O3, ZnO, PbO, SnO. Isliye aluminium oxide aur zinc oxide ko 'amphoteric' kehte hain: ye HCl (acid) se bhi kriya karte hain aur NaOH (base) se bhi, dono avastha mein lavan (aluminium chloride ya sodium aluminate, sodium zincate) banate hain. Gaseous hona, udasin jaleeya ghulaimaan mein ghulna ya lavan na bana paana - ye amphoteric hone ke gun nahi hain. Aise oxides ka istemal dhatu-udyog aur catalysis mein hota hai. Exam point: amphoteric oxides (Al2O3, ZnO) tezaab aur kshaar dono se kriya karke lavan + paani dete hain; ye do-tarfa vyavhaar unki pehchaan hai.

qe: A chemical 'Buffer Solution' resists changes in its hydronium ion concentration (pH) upon the addition of:
qh: बफर विलयन (Buffer Solution) की मुख्य विशेषता क्या होती है?
o: Enormous volumes of boiling water only
Small amounts of either strong acid or strong base
e: Buffer solution wo hai jo tezaab ya kshaar ki thodi matara daalne par apni pH ko lagbhag sthir (constant) rakhta hai - isliye sahi jod 'strong acid ya strong base ki chhoti matara' hai. Aisa isliye hota hai kyunki buffer mein kamzor acid aur uske lavan (jaise CH3COOH + CH3COONa) ya kamzor base aur uske lavan (jaise NH4OH + NH4Cl) ka jod hota hai; ye jod bahar se aaye H+ ya OH- ko apne mein samet leta hai. Organic solvents, catalysts ya ubalta paani daalne se pH sthir rehne ka koi siddhant nahi hai - wo vikalp galat hain. Rakta (blood), mitti aur pool ka paani buffer ke udaharan hain. Exam point: buffer = acid ya base ki thodi matara daalne par pH lagbhag sthir rakhne wala ghulaimaan (kamzor acid/base + uske lavan ka jod).

qe: The 'Henderson-Hasselbalch Equation' is mathematically deployed in physical chemistry to calculate the:
qh: हेंडरसन-हेसेलबाक समीकरण (Henderson-Hasselbalch Equation) का उपयोग क्या ज्ञात करने के लिए किया जाता है?
o: Rate constant of a second-order reaction
pH of an acidic or basic Buffer Solution
e: Henderson-Hasselbalch samikaran physical chemistry mein buffer ghulaimaan ki pH nikaalne ke liye istemal hota hai: pH = pKa + log ([lavan]/[acid]) - isi tarah base ke liye pOH = pKb + log ([lavan]/[base]). Ye samikaran batata hai ki buffer ki pH kamzor acid ke pKa aur lavan-tezaab ke anupat par nirbhar karti hai. Ye samikaran ubalne ki jwala, kriya ki dar (rate) ya nuclear ksharan ka sambandh nahi batata - isliye wo vikalp galat hain, kyunki wo alag vishayon ke samikaran hain. Isi samikaran se pata chalta hai ki jab lavan aur tezaab ki matara barabar ho, tab pH = pKa, yani buffer apne sabse achhe bindu par hota hai. Exam point: Henderson-Hasselbalch samikaran = buffer ki pH nikaalne ke liye (pH = pKa + log([salt]/[acid])).

qe: Why does natural yellow turmeric stain on white fabric turn reddish-brown when scrubbed with soap?
qh: सफेद कपड़े पर लगे हल्दी के पीले दाग पर साबुन लगाने से वह लाल-भूरा क्यों हो जाता है?
o: Soap is alkaline (basic), and turmeric acts as a natural indicator that turns reddish-brown in basic medium
e: Haldi (turmeric) mein curcumin naam ka peela rang hota hai, aur ye ek prakritik indicator hai - jab ise saabuun (soap) jaise kshaariya (basic) padaarth se scrub karte hain to ye laal-bhoora (reddish-brown) ho jaata hai. Isliye sahi jod 'saabuun kshaariya hai aur haldi base mein laal-bhoora hoti hai' wala hai; saabun acid nahi hota (wo kshaar hai), curcumin paani mein turant nahi ghulta aur haldi kapde ke fibre ko bleached nahi karti - ye vikalp galat hain. Dhobi ke kapde dhote samay ye asar aam dikhta hai. Isi tarah haldi ka halwa kaagaz (turmeric paper) bhi base mein laal ho jaata hai. Exam point: haldi ek prakritik indicator hai - kshaariya (base) madhyam mein laal-bhoora, tezaabi madhyam mein peela; saabun base hone se haldi laal-bhoora hoti hai.

qe: What is the 'Basicity' (Proticity) of Sulfuric Acid (H2SO4) in aqueous ionization?
qh: सल्फ्यूरिक अम्ल (H2SO4) की क्षारकता (Basicity) कितनी होती है?
o: 2 (Dibasic, releasing two replaceable H+ ions per molecule)
e: H2SO4 ka 'basicity' (proticity) 2 hai kyunki ye ek angushth paani mein do replaceable hydrogen ion (H+) deta hai: pehle HSO4- aur phir SO4^2- banta hai - isliye ise dibasic acid kehte hain. Basicity ka matlab acid ke ek mole dwara diye jane wale H+ ionon ki sankhya hai, aur ye acid ki 'tezai' (strength) se alag concept hai - ek acid kamzor bhi ho sakta hai par uski basicity zyada ho sakti hai. Tribasic H3PO4 hota hai aur monobasic HCl; 0 basicity asambhav hai kyunki acid kam se kam ek H+ deta hai. Isliye sirf 2 hi sahi jod hai. Exam point: H2SO4 dibasic hai (2 replaceable H+); H3PO4 tribasic aur HCl monobasic acid hai.

qe: Phosphoric Acid (H3PO4) can donate up to three protons sequentially, classifying it as a:
qh: फॉस्फोरिक अम्ल (H3PO4) जलीय विलयन में तीन प्रोटॉन दे सकता है, अतः यह किस प्रकार का अम्ल है?
e: Phosphoric acid (H3PO4) ek angushth mein teen proton (H+) deta hai: H3PO4 -> H2PO4- -> HPO4^2- -> PO4^3- - isliye ise triprotic ya tribasic polyprotic acid kehte hain. Yani ismein teen replaceable hydrogen hote hain, isliye ye ek se adhik proton dene wala acid hai. Diprotic acid keval do H+ deta hai (jaise H2SO4) aur monoprotic sirf ek (jaise HCl); 'aprotic' acid ka matlab hai jismein proton hi nahi hota - wo sahi nahi hai. Iska pehla H+ to aasaani se nikalta hai, par teesra bahut mushkil se, isliye H3PO4 halka acid maana jaata hai, phir bhi 'tribasic' wargikaran sahi rehta hai. Exam point: phosphoric acid H3PO4 = triprotic/tribasic polyprotic acid (teen replaceable H+); H2SO4 diprotic aur HCl monoprotic hai.

qe: Which of the following binary non-metal oxides is strictly 'Neutral' (exhibiting neither acidic nor basic properties)?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा ऑक्साइड पूर्णतः उदासीन (Neutral Oxide) होता है?
o: Nitrous Oxide (N2O / Laughing gas) and Carbon Monoxide (CO)
e: Udasin oksaid (neutral oxides) wo hain jo na tezaab se kriya karte hain na kshaar se - N2O (hansne wali gas), NO aur CO inke mukhya udaharan hain. Isliye CO aur N2O wala jod sahi hai. SO3 aur CO2 acidik oksaide hain (ye paani se kriya karke sulfurik aur carbonik acid banate hain) aur MgO kshaariya oksaid hai (HCl se kriya karke magnesium chloride banata hai) - isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Yaad rakhein: dhatu ke oxides aam taur par kshaariya, adhatu ke oxides aam taur par acidik, aur kuchh khaas oxide (jaise Al2O3, ZnO) amphoteric hote hain; neutral wale bahut kam hain. Exam point: neutral oxides = N2O, NO aur CO; SO3/CO2 acidik aur MgO kshaariya oxide hai.

qe: At 25°C, if an aqueous solution has a pH of 4, what is its corresponding pOH value?
qh: 25°C पर यदि किसी जलीय घोल का pH मान 4 है, तो उसका pOH मान कितना होगा?
e: Paani mein 25 degree C par pH aur pOH ka jod hamesha 14 hota hai, kyunki [H+] x [OH-] = 10^-14. Isliye pH 4 wale ghulaimaan ki pOH = 14 - 4 = 10 hogi; yah us ghulaimaan ke OH- ion ki bahut kam sadhanata darshata hai (kyunki wo acidik hai). '7' us ghulaimaan ka pOH hota agar pH 7 hoti, '4' pH khud hai aur '1' koi sambandh nahi rakhta - isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Dhyan rakhein ki ye jod keval 25 degree C par sahi hai; taapmaan badhne par paani ka ayonik utpaad (ionic product) badal jaata hai, isliye pH + pOH = 14 hamesha sahi nahi hota. Exam point: 25 degree C par pH + pOH = 14; pH 4 hone par pOH 10 hogi.

qe: What happens to the chemical behavior and pH of neutral pure water when its temperature is elevated above 25°C?
qh: जब शुद्ध जल का तापमान 25°C से अधिक बढ़ाया जाता है, तो उसके pH मान पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ता है?
o: pH decreases below 7 due to increased auto-ionization, but water remains strictly neutral ([H+] = [OH-])
e: Taapmaan badhne par paani ka sva-ayonikaran (auto-ionization) badh jaata hai, isliye H+ ion badhne se pH 7 se neeche gir jaati hai - phir bhi paani 'udasin' hi rehta hai kyunki H+ aur OH- ki sadhanata barabar hi rehti hai. Isliye sahi jod yahi hai. pH exactly 7 par nahi rehta, paani prabal acid nahi banta, aur na hi wo kshaariya ho jaata hai, kyunki dono aayan ki matara ek saath badhti hai - yahi 'udasin' (neutral) ki paribhasha hai. 25 degree C ko hi standard maana jaata hai, isliye ye asar ghar par ubaalte paani ko lagane par bhi sookshm (minute) hota hai. Exam point: taapmaan badhne par pH 7 se thodi kam ho jaati hai, par H+ = OH- hone se paani udasin hi rehta hai (25 degree C par hi pH 7 = udasin).

qe: What is the spontaneous 'Self-Ionization' (Autoprotolysis) of water represented by?
qh: जल का स्वतः आयनन (Auto-ionization) किस साम्यावस्था समीकरण द्वारा दर्शाया जाता है?
e: Paani ka sva-ayonikaran (autoprotolysis) ek santulit kriya hai jismein do paani ke angushth milkar ek hydronium ion (H3O+) aur ek hydroxide ion (OH-) banate hain: 2 H2O <=> H3O+ + OH-. Isi karan shudh paani bhi bijli ka halka chalak hota hai aur usme H+ aur OH- dono barabar matara mein hote hain (25 degree C par 10^-7 mol/L each), jisse paani udasin banata hai. H2 banti nahi (wo vidyut apghatan se banti hai), O2- ion paani mein itna sthir nahi rehta, aur NaCl daalne par ye samikaran nahi banata (wo udasin karan ki kriya hai) - isliye baki vikalp galat hain. Exam point: paani ka sva-ayonikaran = 2 H2O <=> H3O+ + OH-; isi se paani mein H+ aur OH- barabar hote hain (10^-7 M, 25 degree C par).

qe: Which of the following common non-prescription antacids relies on a dual combination of baking soda and mild edible organic acid?
qh: बेकिंग पाउडर (Baking Powder) में बेकिंग सोडा के साथ किस हल्के खाद्य अम्ल का मिश्रण होता है?
o: Baking Soda + Tartaric acid (or Potassium hydrogen tartrate)
e: Baking soda (NaHCO3) ke saath tartaric acid ya potassium hydrogen tartrate milane par 'fizz' wala dawa (effervescent antacid) banti hai - paani mein daalte hi ye acid-base kriya se carbon dioxide gas paida karti hai aur ghulaimaan ko udasin karti hai; yahi bahut se antacid sharbat aur powder ka siddhant hai. Bleaching powder, caustic soda, washing soda aise khane yogya (edible) saath nahi banaate - tez base aur tez acid wala jod hai, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Isi udaharan se samajhte hain ki udasin karan kriya sirf lab tak seemit nahi hai, balki rozmarra ki dawa aur khane mein bhi istemal hoti hai. Exam point: effervescent antacid = baking soda (NaHCO3) + tartaric acid/cream of tartar; CO2 gas nikalti hai aur pet ki tezaab udasin hoti hai.

qe: What is the chemical name and crystalline composition of 'Potash Alum' (Fitkari)?
qh: रक्तस्राव रोकने और जल शोधन में प्रयुक्त 'पोटाश फिटकरी' का रासायनिक नाम व प्रकार क्या है?
o: Potassium Aluminum Sulfate Dodecahydrate [K2SO4 · Al2(SO4)3 · 24H2O - Double Salt]
e: Potash alum (Fitkari) ek 'double salt' hai jiska rasayanik naam potassium aluminium sulfate dodecahydrate hai - K2SO4.Al2(SO4)3.24H2O. Double salt ka matlab hai ki usmein do alag lavan ek hi crystal ke roop mein jud kar aate hain, aur paani mein ghulte hi wo phir alag ho jaate hain. Iska istemal paani ko saaf karne (water purification), kapde ke rang ko pakka karne (mordant) aur aftar-seving (blood clotting) mein hota hai. Ferrous ammonium sulfate 'Mohr salt' khlaata hai, sodium potassium tartrate 'Rochelle salt' aur potassium permanganate ek aam oxidising agent hai - isliye ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: potash alum (Fitkari) = potassium aluminium sulfate dodecahydrate [K2SO4.Al2(SO4)3.24H2O], ek double salt; paani saaf karne aur mordant ke roop mein istemal hota hai.

qe: What is the chemical composition of 'Blue Vitriol' (Neela Thotha)?
qh: नीला थोथा (Blue Vitriol) का रासायनिक नाम और क्रिस्टलीय सूत्र क्या है?
e: Blue vitriol (Neela Thotha) ka rasayanik naam copper(II) sulfate pentahydrate hai, jiska formula CuSO4.5H2O hai - ismein paanch paani ke angushth crystal ke bhitar baandhe rehte hain, jo inhe neela rang deti hain. Ise paani mein ghulte hi neela ghulaimaan banta hai, aur isi liye ise fungicide (Bordeaux mixture ka hissa), algicide aur bijnu ki dhulai ke liye istemal karte hain. ZnSO4.7H2O white vitriol hai, FeSO4.7H2O green vitriol aur MgSO4.7H2O Epsom salt hai - isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Garm karne par iska paani nikal jaata hai aur safed (anhydrous) copper sulfate bach jaata hai, jo paani ke saath phir neela ho jaata hai. Exam point: blue vitriol = copper(II) sulfate pentahydrate CuSO4.5H2O (neela); white vitriol ZnSO4.7H2O aur green vitriol FeSO4.7H2O hai.

qe: What is the chemical composition of 'Green Vitriol' (Hara Kasis)?
qh: हरा कसीस (Green Vitriol) का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
e: Green vitriol (Hara Kasis) ka rasayanik naam ferrous sulfate heptahydrate hai, jiska formula FeSO4.7H2O hai - ye hari-neeli (light green) dhool jaisa crystal hota hai aur hawa mein rakhne par dhire-dhire oxidise hokar bhoora ho jaata hai (Fe3+ ban jaata hai). Ise siyah (ink) banane mein, paani saaf karne mein aur dhatu par lep (mordant) ke roop mein istemal karte hain; iske saath Epsom salt ke saath milkar 'Mohr salt' bhi banata hai. Zinc sulfate (ZnSO4.7H2O) safed thotha, copper sulfate (CuSO4.5H2O) neela thotha aur calcium sulfate (CaSO4.2H2O) jipsum kehlata hai - ye teeno is lavan se alag hain, isliye yahi sahi naam hai. Exam point: green vitriol (Hara Kasis) = ferrous sulfate heptahydrate FeSO4.7H2O; hawa mein oxidise hokar bhoora ho jaata hai.

qe: What is the chemical composition of 'White Vitriol' (Safed Thotha)?
qh: सफेद कसीस (White Vitriol) का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
e: White vitriol (Safed Thotha) ka rasayanik naam zinc sulfate heptahydrate hai, jiska formula ZnSO4.7H2O hai - ismein saat paani ke angushth hote hain aur ye safed rang ke crystal banata hai. Iska istemal zinc ki dhatu nikalne, kapde ke rang mein safed-safai (mordant) aur aankh ki dawa (eye drops) tatha dhatu-lep (galvanising ke sahayak) mein hota hai. Magnesium sulfate heptahydrate Epsom salt kehta hai, ferrous sulfate hara kasis aur copper sulfate neela thotha hai - in ka safed thotha se koi sambandh nahi hai. Yaad rakhein: vitriol naam ke chaar aam lavan hain - blue (cuSO4), green (FeSO4), white (ZnSO4) aur oil of vitriol (H2SO4). Exam point: white vitriol = zinc sulfate heptahydrate ZnSO4.7H2O; ise mordant aur zinc dhatu nikalne mein istemal karte hain.

qe: What is the chemical composition of 'Epsom Salt' used medically as an osmotic laxative/purgative?
qh: कब्ज दूर करने और मांसपेशियों की सिकाई के लिए प्रयुक्त 'एप्सम साल्ट' (Epsom Salt) का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
e: Epsom salt ka rasayanik naam magnesium sulfate heptahydrate hai, jiska formula MgSO4.7H2O hai - ise Epsom (England ke sthaan) ke jharnon ke paani se pehchana gaya, aur yahi iska naam ban gaya. Dawa mein ye osmotic laxative (pet saaf karne wali dawa) aur snan ke paani mein muscles ki tagat ke liye istemal hota hai; kheton mein magnesium ki kami door karne ke liye bhi daala jaata hai. Potassium sulfate, sodium sulfate decahydrate (Glauber salt) aur calcium sulfate dihydrate (jipsum) alag lavan hain - isliye ye vikalp galat hain. Iska heptahydrate roop garm karne par paani kho kar safed magnesium sulfate bana deta hai. Exam point: Epsom salt = magnesium sulfate heptahydrate MgSO4.7H2O (osmotic laxative); Glauber salt Na2SO4.10H2O aur jipsum CaSO4.2H2O hai.

qe: What is 'Glauber's Salt' chemically?
qh: ग्लोबर लवण (Glauber's Salt) का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
e: Glauber's salt ka rasayanik naam sodium sulfate decahydrate hai, jiska formula Na2SO4.10H2O hai - ismein das paani ke angushth hote hain. Iski khaas baat hai ki ye sasta aur prabhavi thirst-laxative (pet saaf karne wali dawa) ke roop mein kaam karta hai, aur garmi jamane wale (thermal storage) system mein bhi istemal hota hai kyunki ye ghulne-par crystallise hone ke samay garmi leta-chhodta hai. ZnSO4.7H2O white vitriol, Ferrous sulfate (FeSO4.7H2O) hara kasis kehlata hai, aur magnesium sulfate (MgSO4.7H2O) Epsom salt ke naam se bikta hai - ye dono Glauber salt nahi hain. Ise 1625 mein Johann Glauber ne pehli baar banaya tha, isliye iska naam unhi par pada. Exam point: Glauber's salt = sodium sulfate decahydrate Na2SO4.10H2O; iska istemal dawa aur thermal storage mein hota hai.

qe: What is 'Chile Saltpetre' chemically?
qh: चिली साल्टपीटर (Chile Saltpetre) का रासायनिक नाम व सूत्र क्या है?
e: Chile saltpetre ka rasayanik naam sodium nitrate (NaNO3) hai - 'saltpetre' (shora) naam nitrate larne wale lavan ke liye istemal hota hai, aur ye khaas lavan Chile desh ki Atacama marusthal (desert) mein bahut milta tha, isliye 'Chile saltpetre' kehlaya. Iska istemal khad (fertiliser) ke roop mein aur aajkal garmi jamane wale (solar thermal) kaam mein bhi hota hai, kyunki ye garmi soakh (absorb) kar leta hai. Indian saltpetre potassium nitrate (KNO3) hai, ammonium nitrate khad-cum-vishforak hai aur silver nitrate 'lunar caustic' kehta hai - isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Isliye sahi jod sodium nitrate (NaNO3) hai. Exam point: Chile saltpetre = sodium nitrate (NaNO3); Indian saltpetre = potassium nitrate (KNO3); dono nitrate shora warg ke lavan hain.

qe: What is 'Lunar Caustic' chemically, famous for leaving indelible black marks on skin and fingernails during voting?
qh: मतदान के समय उंगली पर लगाई जाने वाली अमिट स्याही और 'लूनर कास्टिक' का रासायनिक नाम क्या है?
e: Lunar Caustic ka rasayanik naam silver nitrate (AgNO3) hai - ye ek bina rang (colorless) crystal hai jo prakash mein rakhne par kaala padasth ho jaata hai. Ise matdan (voting) ke dauran ummidwar ke ungli par nishaan lagane ke liye istemal kiya jaata tha, kyunki ye skin aur nakhun par gehra kaala nishaan bana deta hai jo lagbhag nahi mit. Iske alava ye kaanch (glass) par, photo-udyog (photography) mein aur dhaat par lep (silvering) mein bhi kaam aata hai. Mercuric chloride, potassium permanganate aur sodium nitrate alag rasayan hain - isliye wo vikalp galat hain. 'Lunar' naam chandi (silver) ke chand jaisa safed-chamakte roop se joda jaata hai. Exam point: lunar caustic = silver nitrate (AgNO3); chunav ke dauran ungli par kaala nishaan lagane ke liye istemal hota hai.

qe: What is the corrosive, highly fuming reagent termed 'Aqua Regia' (Royal Water)?
qh: सोना (Gold) और प्लेटिनम जैसी उत्कृष्ट धातुओं को घोलने वाले 'अम्लराज' (Aqua Regia) का रासायनिक अनुपात क्या होता है?
o: Concentrated HCl and Concentrated HNO3 in a 3:1 volumetric ratio
Conc. H2SO4 and Conc. HNO3 in 3:1 ratio
Conc. HCl and Conc. H2SO4 in 1:1 ratio
e: Aqua regia (Royal Water) ko 3 bhaag gaadha (concentrated) hydrochloric acid (HCl) aur 1 bhaag gaadha nitric acid (HNO3) milakar banaya jaata hai - ye anupat yaad rakhna zaroori hai (HCl : HNO3 = 3:1). Iska ek khaas gun yahi hai ki ye sona (gold) aur platinum jaise 'rajakiya' (noble) dhatuon ko bhi ghula leta hai, kyunki yahan nitric acid dhatu ko oxidise karta hai aur HCl se banne wala chloride ion ghulansheel complex (jaise chloroaurate) bana deta hai. Ise 'royal water' kaha jaata hai kyunki ye raja dhatuon ko pighla leta hai. H2SO4 aur HNO3 ka jod, HCl aur H2SO4 ka jod, ya keval fuming nitric acid - ye sab aqua regia ke samikaran nahi hain. Exam point: Aqua regia = 3:1 (HCl : HNO3); ye sona aur platinum ko ghula deta hai, isliye 'royal water' kaha jaata hai.

qe: Which salt is utilized as the primary photographic 'Fixer' (Hypo) in traditional silver halide photography?
qh: फोटोग्राफी में निगेटिव को स्थायी करने के लिए 'हाइपो' (Hypo) के रूप में किस रसायन का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Photography mein 'fixer' ka kaam aise sone (silver) ke lavan ko hatana hota hai jo film par bina prakash ke bache rehte hain; isi kaam ke liye sodium thiosulfate pentahydrate (Na2S2O3.5H2O) ka istemal hota hai, jise 'hypo' bhi kehte hain. Ye undeveloped silver bromide ke saath ghulansheel complex (sodium argentothiosulfate) bana deta hai, jisse film par kaala vaada sthir (fix) ho jaata hai aur photo hamesha bani rehti hai. Potassium cyanide zehreela hai aur aise kaam mein istemal nahi hota, silver bromide film par pehle se lagi hoti hai (fixer nahi hai) aur sodium sulfite ko developer/parisarvan mein istemal karte hain - isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: photographic fixer (hypo) = sodium thiosulfate pentahydrate Na2S2O3.5H2O; ye unreacted silver halide ko ghula kar film par photo sthir karta hai.

qe: Which light-sensitive silver halide salt is uniformly suspended in photographic film gelatin emulsions?
qh: ब्लैक एंड व्हाइट फोटोग्राफी की रील/फिल्म पर किस प्रकाश-संवेदनशील लवण की परत चढ़ाई जाती है?
e: Traditional photographic film ki parat (gelatin emulsion) mein chandini (silver) ka aisa halide saman roop se baandha jaata hai jo prakash par asar le - yahi silver bromide (AgBr) hai, jo halka peela-safed thos (solid) hota hai aur prakash ke girne par aasanipoorvak silver aur bromine mein vichchhedit (decompose) ho jaata hai. Isi vichchhedan se film par 'chhipa hua chitra' (latent image) banta hai, jise developer, stop bath aur fixer ki madad se sthir kiya jaata hai. Silver iodide, silver nitrate aur silver chloride bhi saman roop se aise kisi kaam mein istemal nahi hote ya bhut kam hota hai, kyunki AgBr ki prakash-sunshine (light sensitivity) film ke liye sabse upyogi hoti hai. Exam point: photographic film mein saman roop se baandhe halide = silver bromide (AgBr); prakash se ye silver aur bromine mein toot jaata hai (latent image).

qe: Which non-mineral acid is artificially added to dark carbonated beverages (Colas) to provide a sharp, tangy bite?
qh: कोल्ड ड्रिंक्स (जैसे कोला) में तीखा स्वाद देने और फफूंद रोकने के लिए कौन सा अम्ल मिलाया जाता है?
e: Phosphoric acid (H3PO4) ko dark karbonated peyon (Cola drinks) mein 'tangy' swaad aur halka khatta asar dene ke liye daala jaata hai - ye cola ke asli swaad-jaal ka hissa hai. Dhyan rakhein ki ye khaniz (mineral) acid hai par khane-yogya shudhta (food-grade) mein istemal hota hai, isliye ye aapke sharir ko bahut kam nuksan pahunchata hai; isi karan ise khad (fertiliser) aur metal-treating mein bhi istemal karte hain. Sulfuric acid, nitric acid zaharila aur khaniz hain isliye khane mein istemal nahi hote, aur carbonic acid cola mein paani aur CO2 se bhi banta hai par cola ka khatta 'bite' phosphoric acid se aata hai. Exam point: cola drinks mein daala jane wala khaas acid = phosphoric acid (H3PO4), jo khane-yogya shudhta mein milaya jaata hai.

qe: Which olfactory indicators lose their characteristic scent completely in an alkaline (basic) solution?
qh: घ्राण सूचक (Olfactory Indicators) जैसे वैनिला और प्याज का अर्क क्षारीय माध्यम में क्या प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं?
o: Their characteristic smell completely vanishes/disappears in basic solutions
e: Olfactory indicators (gandh-wale indicators) wo padaarth hain jinki gandh (smell) tezaabi ya kshaariya madhyam mein badal jaati hai - jaise vanilla, onion aur clove. Inmein sabse khaas gun yahi hai ki kshaariya (basic) ghulaimaan mein unki khushbu poori tarah gayab ho jaati hai, jabki tezaab mein gandh bani rehti hai. Isi gun ka istemal school prayogon mein base ki pehchaan ke liye hota hai - jaise onion ki gandh tezaab mein tez rehti hai par base mein mit jaati hai. 'Gandh tez ho jaati hai', 'tezaabi ho jaati hai' ya 'rang laal ho jaata hai' - ye teen vikalp indicator ke is khaas gun ko nahi batate, isliye galat hain. Exam point: olfactory indicators (vanilla, onion, clove) kshaariya madhyam mein gandh kho dete hain; ye base ki pehchaan ka aasan tarika hai.

qe: What is the spontaneous phenomenon of a hydrated salt losing its water of crystallization to air and becoming powdery called?
qh: हवा में खुला रखने पर किसी लवण के क्रिस्टलन जल का उड़ जाना और उसका चूर्ण बन जाना क्या कहलाता है?
e: Efflorescence (Utphullan) wo ghatna hai jismein ek jal-yukt lavan (hydrated salt) apne crystal ka paani (water of crystallization) hawa mein chhod deta hai aur sookh kar bhurbhura churn (powder) ban jaata hai - jaise washing soda (Na2CO3.10H2O) ya Glauber salt (Na2SO4.10H2O) hawa mein khule chhode jaane par apna paani kho dete hain. Desiccation ka matlab hai jaanbujh kar paani hatana, deliquescence mein nami soakh kar ghul jaana aur hygroscopy mein nami soakh kar bas geele ho jaana - ye alag ghatnayein hain, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Isliye efflorescence ko 'bahir-pushti' (bahar ki taraf paani nikalna) ke arth mein bhi samjha jaata hai, jaise purani deewaron par safed churn. Exam point: efflorescence = hydrated lavan ka hawa mein paani kho kar powder (churn) ban jaana; jaise washing soda aur Glauber salt ka sookhna.

qe: What is the property of anhydrous salts (like solid NaOH or CaCl2) absorbing atmospheric moisture to the point of dissolving in it?
qh: हवा से इतनी नमी सोख लेना कि लवण खुद उसी पानी में घुलकर द्रव बन जाए, क्या कहलाता है?
e: Deliquescence (Prasvedan) wo gun hai jismein kuchh aise lavan jo 'hygroscopic' hote hain, hawa ki nami (water vapour) ko itna soakh lete hain ki wo apne hi absorbed paani mein ghul kar ghulaimaan (solution) ban jaate hain - jaise solid NaOH, CaCl2, FeCl3 aur ZnCl2 hawa mein khule rakhe jaane par chikat (sticky) ho jaate hain. Iska practical istemal desiccator (silica gel ke saath) aur kheton-rojon ke bhitar nami rokne mein hota hai. Evaporation (bhaap banna), efflorescence (paani khona) aur sublimation (thos se seedha gas) - ye alag prakriyaayein hain, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Hygroscopy aur deliquescence ka farq yahi hai ki deliquescence mein lavan nami mein ghul kar paani ban jaata hai. Exam point: deliquescence (Prasvedan) = lavan ka hawa ki nami soakh kar apne hi paani mein ghul jaana; jaise NaOH, CaCl2, FeCl3; isse milta-julta gun hygroscopy hai.
